description: Close or partially reduce a mock futures position. fraction in (0,1] reduces partially; omit (or 1) for a full close. idempotencyKey is REQUIRED. Requires the trade:futures scope. Paper trading only (virtual mUSD). Fills follow paper_execution_v1 with a disclosed execution cost; see executionModel in quote/trade results.

agentTrace.description: Optional private trace metadata stored in the caller's ledger.

decisionId.description: Agent decision id for quote/write attribution.

rationaleSummary.description: Optional concise rationale summary. Do not include chain-of-thought, secrets, or account identity.

strategyLabel.description: Short strategy label, self-reported by the caller.

fraction.description: (0,1] portion to close; omit/1 = full close.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique per close intent; reuse replays the original result.

positionId.description: Open futures position id to close or reduce.

name: close_futures_position
title: Close futures position
